item.description:
Koegaki 1.13.3

  • This release is for the Mac. Windows stays on 1.13.1 and Linux on 1.14.0.
  • On the Mac, quitting Koegaki with Clean on, or letting it quit to install a later update, no longer leaves a crash report, and the app no longer comes straight back after you quit it.
  • On the Mac, a dictation no longer waits on Koegaki's own bookkeeping when your Mac is busy: the paste goes out as soon as the text is ready, and a slow sound cue can only delay the cue.
  • On the Mac, Settings now says what Cmd V pastes after a dictation: the dictation itself, still the default, or what you had copied before.
